name: yugamc-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Yugamc frontend and backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Yugamc-backend && npm install --prefix Yugamc-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix Yugamc-backend" "npm run dev --prefix Yugamc-frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Yugamc-backend" "npm run dev --prefix Yugamc-frontend"
